lines.text: We have a high priest who sat at the right hand of the throne in heaven and ministers in the true tabernacle.
Every high priest offers gifts and sacrifices, but if Jesus were on earth, He would not be a priest.
Moses was warned to build the tabernacle according to the pattern shown him on Mount Sinai.
God found fault with the people and promised a new covenant with Israel and Judah, unlike the one made when He led them out of Babylon.
God will put His laws in their minds, write them on their hearts, forgive their iniquities, and remember their sins no more.
